messages:
maria: quick summary from BankCo call — they want a committed peak window: 500 rps sustained per-tenant for 2h/day, with short spikes to 1.2k rps (<5m). They want reserved capacity in GovCloud + a written fallback plan. HIPAA items flagged in questionnaire.
raj: clarifying q — 500 rps is per tenant org (confirmed). what avg tokens should we assume?
emma: bank replied ~40 prompt + ~60 response ≈100 tokens per request. they prefer reserved nodes but asked for cost delta vs burst.
tom: rough perf math on our runtime: ~0.02 GPU-sec per 100-token request. 500 rps → ~10 GPU-sec/s ⇒ ~10 GPUs sustained. recommend baseline 12 reserved (redundancy), 14 recommended for safety, autoscale to 18 for spikes.
raj: KV cache warmup is a must for their chat flows — cold KV will spike p99. propose scheduled KV preload during the 2h window + prewarm slots.
maria: they also asked: what happens if spot/eviction occurs in GovCloud? they want graceful degradation and predictable tail latencies.
tom: fallback design idea: pre-prepare a quantized variant (2x throughput on same GPU) and a smaller-context model as second fallback. policy example: if queue_delay > 200ms OR node_eviction_detected → shift 30% traffic to quantized tier; if errors > 1% OR queue_delay > 400ms → failover to quantized for 100%. test monthly.
raj: autoscale snippet (to include in runbook):
``nmin_reserved: 12
prewarm_schedule: "daily 09:00-11:00"
scale_metric: p95_queue_latency_ms
scale_up: +2 nodes per 30s if p95_queue_latency_ms > 150
scale_down: -1 node per 5m if avg_utilization < 40%
burst_max_nodes: 18
fallback_thresholds: queue_delay_ms:200, error_rate_pct:1.0
```
maria: finance ask — short delta for reserved 14 GPUs vs on-demand burst to 18 for 2h/day across a 30-day month. procurement needs numbers.
tom: ballpark: reserved commit saves ~25-35% vs on-demand; GovCloud SKUs have ~10% premium. finance will give exact.
emma: SLA wording draft for legal: "SLA window: 99.5% availability and p95 latency < 250ms during scheduled 2h peak. Fallback policy and monthly failover test included in onboarding annex." tag legal for review.
maria: security checklist: KMS integration required, audit logs exported to GovCloud S3 for 1yr retention, HSM optional add-on. any GovCloud blockers?
raj: KMS supported but GovCloud IAM mapping needs custom onboarding script; audit export supported but must be specified in SOW; HSM procurement separate.
tom: ops note: private control plane + GovCloud provisioning ~3-4 weeks lead time. preheat & KV preload in week 1.
raj: I'll add prewarm CLI and KV preload steps to INF-4269; expected cache hit metrics included.
maria: BankCo asked for a short POC runbook and a load script — tom can you share a snippet we can run?
tom: put this in POC docs:
``n# 10m steady at 600rps
./loadgen --rps 600 --duration 600 --model chat-v2 --avg-tokens 100 --org bankco-prod
# spike test: 2 bursts of 180s at 1.2k rps
./loadgen --rps 1200 --duration 180 --repeat 2 --org bankco-prod
```
emma: ops acceptance: run 30m smoke at 600rps and the 1.2k spike bursts to validate autoscale + fallback.
maria: next actions — tom/raj: ops runbook + autoscale snippet + KV preload steps; finance: reserved vs on-demand delta; raj: security questionnaire answers; emma: SLA wording for legal; schedule 30m walkthrough with BankCo (they proposed Wed 10:00 ET).
deploy-bot: INF-4269 created for GovCloud provisioning + KMS onboarding (assignees: tom, raj).
BankCo-tech: (DM) Wed 10:00 ET works for runbook walkthrough.
maria: leaving this thread as canonical runbook draft — I'll post procurement numbers when finance replies and then we can lock SOW language.
